skills.name: comparisons
skills.description: How to structure A vs B comparisons in Fullstory — when to use dimensionality (event/session properties) vs separate segments (user-level properties), and why the distinction matters for correctness.
headings: Why the wrong choice produces wrong results
skills.description_zh: 指导 Fullstory A/B 比较结构，区分事件/会话属性适用的维度细分与用户级属性适用的独立分群，确保比较口径正确。

skills.name: general-analysis
skills.description: Fullstory analytics workflow. Use when answering a question that requires measuring user behavior — counts, rates, trends, breakdowns, or cohort comparisons. Builds segments and metrics, computes results, then investigates sessions to explain what the numbers mean.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Fullstory 度量用户行为，建立分群和指标、计算数量、比率、趋势、细分及群组对比，再调查会话解释数字含义。

skills.name: session-review
skills.description: Use when diagnosing user-reported issues, investigating bugs, analyzing user behavior, or validating UI correctness using Fullstory session recordings.
skills.description_zh: 使用 Fullstory 会话录屏诊断用户问题、调查缺陷、分析行为或验证界面正确性。
